Future analogous cases (e.g., security keyword with other products and severity 2) would need similar intersection rules.

Regla especifica que cubre la interseccion de H02 (security+severity<=2) y H20 (dashboard+severity<=2). Al ser subconjunto de ambas, gana automaticamente sin necesidad de declarar prioridad.

The rule is a strict subset of both H02 (security+severity≤2) and H19 (mobile+severity=2), so it automatically wins via set containment. No priority declarations needed.

This rule specializes H01 to business tier only. It must override all non-contained rules that could match a security incident for business, as security takes precedence over technical, billing, and self-service queues.

Para mobile, se declara prioridad sobre H19 porque H19 solo aplica a severidad exactamente 2, mientras que nuestra regla cubre 1 y 2; para los demás productos, la regla es un subconjunto de las reglas existentes y gana automáticamente.
